So test for empty schemas false case already covered? The existing test for false with empty schemas expects empty set and no walks. We can simply invoke walk with null executionContext and expect NullPointerException; we don't need to stub validate; we can let it call real method which may NPE. Use Field field = AnyOfValidator.class.getDeclaredField("schemas"); field.setAccessible(true); field.set(validator, null); Then call walk and expect NullPointerException.

Then call walk false and expect NPE when iterating.
